claim: A history guard that compares a record against `git show HEAD:<path>` protects that record's past.

environment.what: any git-backed record with a monotonicity guard
assumptions: the guard runs in CI after the change is committed

witness.expect: 'an exclusion deleted in a later commit' is rejected — the case builds a real repository and commits the deletion before asserting
witness.negative_control: the same suite accepts the unmodified record, so the check is not rejecting everything

applies_until: The guard reads revisions other than HEAD, or the record is verified against an anchor outside the repository.

cost.to_discover: one adversarial review round; the defect survived a full green gate
